title.es: Cambio de andén para el tren 6

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre travel information.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about travel information.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Attention passengers for train 6 to Northbridge. The train will leave from platform 3 today, not platform 1. Please check your ticket before you walk downstairs. The train arrives at ten twenty and leaves at ten thirty. Passengers with large bags can use the lift beside the ticket office. The café near platform 3 is open until noon.

The train arrives at ten twenty and leaves at ten thirty. Passengers with large bags can use the lift beside the ticket office. The café near platform 3 is open until noon.
